fields.title: PBO humidity-dose criterion
fields.finding: 5%of cold saturation is an inference from dry protected-yarn evidence, not a demonstrated long-term loaded-laminate safe boundary.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure loaded PBO/resin/interface strength retention under the full coupled moisture, temperature and light history.

claim: 5%of cold saturation is an inference from dry protected-yarn evidence, not a demonstrated long-term loaded-laminate safe boundary. | PBO humidity-dose criterion
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
